caption: The drawing consists of two main sections: one upper area with hanging decorative garlands and one lower area with a rectangular horizontal frieze. In the upper section, there are two horizontal garlands, each made up of repeating small, red, tassel-like shapes connected by a curved line of green and red dots and yellow circular accents at each end. Each garland is anchored at both ends with a round yellow and red floral medallion, and both are suspended from a larger central yellow, red, and violet floral medallion. Two smaller, circular yellow and red floral motifs are placed symmetrically to the left and right of the central medallion. The second garland, below the first, repeats the red, green, and yellow color scheme with similar floral and tassel motifs, along with small spiral flourishes. In the lower section, a broad horizontal border is filled with a repeating geometric pattern made up of diamonds, triangles, and lines in red, light blue, yellow, and green. Above this geometric band is a row of alternating floral and stylized leaf motifs, primarily in yellow, green, and red. The flowers are circular and sun-shaped with red petals, while the yellow motifs resemble stylized, symmetrical blossoms or vases. The entire composition uses clean lines and is rendered on a light beige background, giving prominence to the pastel and bright hues of the ornaments.
title: Wall Decorations (Drawing Made from a Restoration)
